newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins $150 mln Turk GSM contract.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins $150 mln Turk GSM contract.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group AB LM Ericsson said on Friday it won a contract worth $150 million to expand Turkey's Turkcell GSM (global system for telecommunications) Network.
"The contract is a turnkey project that includes new radio base stations, switching equipment and services valued at $150 million," Ericsson said in a statement.
It said deliveries would start in 1997 and continue until mid-1998.
Turkcell is the largest GSM operator in Turkey, it said. It has 890,000 subscribers or 85 percent of the market.
